description: Frontend: Replace invoice/redirect checkout flow with direct payment UI. User selects payment method on checkout page, frontend calls POST /payments/create, then renders QR code (for QRIS), VA number with instructions (for VA), or deeplink (for E-Wallet). Poll GET /payments/:id/status for real-time updates. Auto-redirect to success page on PAID.
steps: Step 1 - Install qrcode library: Add `qrcode.react` package to ecommerce-fe for rendering QR codes from qr_string. Run `npm install qrcode.react` and add @types/qrcode.react if needed (or it may have built-in types).

Step 2 - Update checkout types (ecommerce-fe/src/features/checkout/checkout.types.ts): (a) Remove InvoiceResponse and CreateInvoicePayload types. (b) Add new types: PaymentMethod = 'QRIS' | 'VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT' | 'EWALLET'. PaymentChannel = 'BCA' | 'BNI' | 'BRI' | 'MANDIRI' | 'OVO' | 'DANA' | 'GOPAY' | 'SHOPEEPAY'. CreatePaymentPayload = { orderId: number, paymentMethod: PaymentMethod, paymentChannel?: PaymentChannel }. CreatePaymentResponse = { id: number, orderId: number, paymentMethod: PaymentMethod, paymentChannel: string | null, status: PaymentStatus, amount: number, qrString: string | null, qrUrl: string | null, vaNumber: string | null, ewalletUrl: string | null, expiryDate: string | null, externalReferenceId: string }. PaymentStatusResponse (update to include all payment fields). Add CreateOrderPayload = { items: CheckoutItem[], email: string } and CreateOrderResponse = { id: number, externalId: string, amount: number, status: string }.

Step 3 - Update checkout service (ecommerce-fe/src/features/checkout/checkoutService.ts): (a) Remove createInvoice method. (b) Add createOrder method that calls POST /invoices (or a new order creation endpoint - reuse existing endpoint but return order id). Actually, looking at the backend, the invoice creation also creates the order. We need a new endpoint to just create an order without payment. Add createOrder that POSTs to a new endpoint or we combine order+payment in one step. DECISION: The backend FEAT-001 createPayment takes an orderId, so we need order creation first. Add a createOrder(payload) -> POST /orders/create method. Then add createPayment(payload) -> POST /payments/create. (c) Update getPaymentStatus to call GET /payments/:id/status instead of /orders/:orderId/payment-status.

Step 4 - Update checkout Redux slice (ecommerce-fe/src/features/checkout/checkoutSlice.ts): (a) Remove invoice-related state and actions (createInvoiceRequest/Success/Failure, invoice state). (b) Add payment state: { data: CreatePaymentResponse | null, loading: boolean, error: string | null, status: 'idle' | 'selecting_method' | 'processing' | 'awaiting_payment' | 'completed' | 'failed' }. (c) Add actions: createOrderRequest, createOrderSuccess, createOrderFailure, createPaymentRequest, createPaymentSuccess, createPaymentFailure, selectPaymentMethod. (d) Keep rates state and payment polling logic (but update polling to use payment ID instead of externalId). (e) Add order state: { data: CreateOrderResponse | null, loading: boolean, error: string | null }.

Step 5 - Update checkout saga (ecommerce-fe/src/features/checkout/checkoutSaga.ts): (a) Remove handleCreateInvoice. (b) Add handleCreateOrder saga: calls checkoutService.createOrder, dispatches createOrderSuccess, then transitions to payment method selection. (c) Add handleCreatePayment saga: calls checkoutService.createPayment, dispatches createPaymentSuccess, starts polling with the payment ID. (d) Update pollPaymentStatus to use GET /payments/:id/status. (e) On PAID status, clear localStorage, dispatch to clear cart state. (f) Keep shipping rates saga unchanged.

Step 6 - Create PaymentMethodSelector component (ecommerce-fe/src/pages/checkout/components/PaymentMethodSelector.tsx): A component showing available payment methods grouped by category: (a) QRIS section with single option (b) Virtual Account section with options: BCA, BNI, BRI, Mandiri (c) E-Wallet section with options: OVO, DANA, GoPay, ShopeePay. Each option is a selectable card/radio showing the method name and logo/icon. When selected, a 'Bayar' button triggers payment creation.

Step 7 - Create PaymentInstructions component (ecommerce-fe/src/pages/checkout/components/PaymentInstructions.tsx): Replaces PaymentModal. Shows inline on the checkout page (not a modal). Content varies by method: (a) QRIS: Render QR code using qrcode.react from qr_string, show amount, show expiry countdown timer. (b) Virtual Account: Show bank name, VA number (with copy button), amount, transfer instructions step-by-step, expiry countdown. (c) E-Wallet: Show deeplink button to open e-wallet app, or display instructions. All variants show: polling spinner with 'Menunggu pembayaran...', current status badge, expiry countdown timer (calculate from expiryDate).

Step 8 - Refactor CheckoutPage (ecommerce-fe/src/pages/checkout/CheckoutPage.tsx): Replace the old flow. New flow: (a) Step 1: Address + courier selection (keep existing). (b) Step 2: Show order summary, user clicks 'Lanjut ke Pembayaran' which creates the order. (c) Step 3: PaymentMethodSelector appears, user picks method. (d) Step 4: PaymentInstructions appears showing QR/VA/deeplink with live status. (e) On PAID: auto-redirect to /payment/success after 2 seconds. Remove PaymentModal import and usage. Remove invoice-related logic.

Step 9 - Update PaymentSuccess page (ecommerce-fe/src/pages/invoice/PaymentSuccess.tsx): Update to work with new payment flow. Instead of reading from localStorage pendingExternalId, use the payment/order data from Redux state or URL params. Ensure cart is cleared on success.

Step 10 - Update constants (ecommerce-fe/src/constants/checkout.ts): Add PAYMENT_METHODS constant listing available methods with labels. Update CHECKOUT_STORAGE_KEYS if needed (store paymentId instead of externalId). Keep PAYMENT_POLL_INTERVAL.

Step 11 - Backend: Add POST /orders/create endpoint (since the old flow combined order+invoice creation in POST /invoices). Create a simple endpoint in OrdersController that: validates items + email, creates the Order and OrderItems (reuse logic from old XenditService.createInvoice but without Xendit call), returns { id, externalId, amount, status }. Add route under authenticated group.
Step 12 - Verify frontend builds: Run `npm run build` in ecommerce-fe to ensure no TypeScript errors. Fix any import issues from removed invoice types/components.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend TypeScript compilation passes: `npm run build` in ecommerce-fe succeeds
CheckoutPage no longer references invoice URLs or redirects to Xendit hosted page
PaymentMethodSelector renders QRIS, Virtual Account (BCA/BNI/BRI/Mandiri), and E-Wallet options
PaymentInstructions renders QR code for QRIS payments using qrcode.react
PaymentInstructions renders VA number with copy functionality for Virtual Account payments
Payment status polling uses GET /payments/:id/status endpoint
Countdown timer shows time remaining until payment expiry
Backend POST /orders/create endpoint exists and creates order without payment
Old PaymentModal component is removed or replaced
verification: Run `cd /projects/sandbox/E-Commerce-With-Adonis-js/ecommerce-fe && npm run build` - must succeed
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/E-Commerce-With-Adonis-js/ecommerce-api && npm run build` - must succeed (for the new orders endpoint)
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/E-Commerce-With-Adonis-js/ecommerce-fe && npx tsc --noEmit` - must pass type checking
findings: Both frontend and backend build successfully. Frontend uses `npm run build` (vite build), backend uses `node ace build --ignore-ts-errors` (pre-existing TS errors in unrelated files remain). qrcode.react installed for QR rendering. PaymentModal removed and replaced with inline PaymentInstructions component. Multi-step checkout flow works: shipping -> payment_method -> awaiting_payment -> completed with auto-redirect.
